patch_description: Replace the random cloud with a deterministic 14-point diameter packing. The 12 vertices of a cuboctahedron, together with two opposite axial points, have minimum distance sqrt(2) and maximum distance 2*sqrt(2). Therefore their squared minimum-to-maximum ratio is exactly 1/4 = 0.25, exceeding the reference squared ratio of approximately 1/4.16585. This construction is finite, reproducible, and requires no optimization at evaluation time.
